title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Fruit Mix Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Fruit Mix Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod combines a variety of fruit flavours for a bright, juicy vape. Sweet and tangy notes weave together for a balanced profile that’s vibrant, smooth, and easy to enjoy at any time of day. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. Together they deliver up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, with no messy refilling or coil replacements needed. Built with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures clear flavour and smooth vapour production from beginning to end. Designed for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re set to go.
